text:
Alex (Sales): Hey team — ACME just reported a cascade of 429s this morning. They say they're being throttled by per-tenant rate limits during a launch spike. Can we do a temporary quota override for the next 48h while we triage?

Elena (Support): Putting this on the queue. Customer reports peak sustained ~12 rps on gen endpoints, bursts up to 35 rps. Their current tenant quota is 10 rps. Logs: https://redwood.internal/s/req/ACME-987

Maria (eng-sre): @Alex heads-up: cluster has active backpressure/admission control. Current snapshot: us-west1-gpu pool is at ~91% GPU utilization. Queueing is non-trivial — we'll risk worsening other tenants' latency. Not comfortable with an open override.

Maria (eng-sre): metrics snippet:
```
zone: us-west1-gpu
gpus_total: 140
gpus_used: 128
queue_length_tokens: 420000
avg_queue_wait_ms: 2800
admission_drop_rate: 0.12
```

Devon (infra-lead): We have two paths: 1) short, tenant-scoped soft-override with tight circuit-breakers and auto-revert (hours), or 2) provision Dedicated slice for ACME (days, billable). Option 1 is doable but will increase queue pressure for others.

Alex (Sales): Customer says launch is tomorrow and they accept risk. They asked for cost delta too — do we have a rough ops cost for a 6-48h bump?

Maria (eng-sre): Quick back-of-envelope: if they run an extra ~150k tokens/hr in generation, that maps to higher GPU time. I'll ping finance for exact $/day. For safety, prefer 6h incremental step, monitor, then extend if stable.

Elena (Support): Customer agrees to start with 6h pilot. They want rollback plan and monitoring links.

Devon (infra-lead): Rollback plan: auto-revert at expiry + alert-driven revoke. Thresholds: revoke override immediately if queue_length_tokens > 800000 OR avg_queue_wait_ms > 5000. CLI to apply override: 
```
redwood-cli quota-override apply --tenant acme --rate 20 --burst 40 --duration 6h --circuit-breaker "queue_tokens>800000,avg_wait_ms>5000" --owner @devon
```

Devon (infra-lead): Note: autoscaler is currently in cooldown (recent scale-down), so adding GPUs in us-west1 will be blocked for ~35m. Ops-Bot posted an alert.

Ops-Bot: Alert: autoscaler cooldown active for zone us-west1-gpu (next scale_inhibited 2100s).

Oncall-Bot: Incident created: INC-2024-0721 — capacity pressure in us-west1. Pager schedule notified.

Maria (eng-sre): OK. I'm willing to support a tenant-scoped override for 6h with the circuit-breakers Devon listed. @Devon please apply now and add Grafana panel for the tenant.

Devon (infra-lead): Applying override now. Will post confirmation and keep watch.

Devon (infra-lead): Override applied for tenant acme: rate=20rps, burst=40, expires in 6h. Monitoring: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/ops/queue?var-tenant=acme — watching queue_length and avg_wait_ms. :thumbsup:

Elena (Support): Customer notified and will ramp slowly. Leaving thread open for any flare-ups.

Maria (eng-sre): If we see queue length trending up in 20m, we'll revoke and revert to conservative defaults. Thanks all.
thread_preview: ACME requests temporary quota override due to launch spikes; eng-sre discusses cluster saturation, suggests 6h tenant-scoped override with circuit-breakers; override applied and monitoring set up.
